verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a programmatic SDK (TypeScript/Python/Go) with local browser launch, CDP attach, and Browserbase cloud session options, which implies it can run without a UI and be scripted into pipelines, but no evidence explicitly mentions a headless flag, CI/CD examples, or GitHub Actions integration. missing for 10: explicit headless-mode documentation, CI/CD pipeline examples or guides, independent confirmation of running Stagehand unattended in automated build environments.
